changelog: Fix: 2026_09_17_0005's pre-flight guard asserted SUM(pnl) = -120.07 for challenge 6; live's actual SUM(pnl) is -120.08. Not a data error -- -120.07 came from deriving the figure as (account total -264.8228) minus (costs 144.7528), two values already rounded to 4 decimals, rather than from summing the 59 pnl rows directly. -120.08 is confirmed against live and is the value now asserted

Fix: the 59 fee UPDATEs now write net_pnl = pnl - <fee>, referencing each row's own stored pnl column instead of a literal copied from bitfunded-altcoin-fees.csv. That CSV's own pnl column sums to -120.07, a cent different from live's actual trades.pnl on at least one row -- referencing the column guarantees net_pnl is always correct relative to whatever pnl is actually stored, without needing to identify which row differs

Fix: derived-balance targets corrected accordingly -- net_pnl now sums to -258.1959 (not -258.1859), so the derived balance is 9735.1672 (not 9735.1772). Bitfunded reports 9735.1772; a one-cent residual between that and this account's derived balance is documented in CLAUDE.md rather than forced to match by adjusting funding_adjustment or any fee. Dashboard balance card should read $9,735.17, not $9,735.18

No other changes -- 0004 and 0006 are untouched. 0005 was still status='failed' on live (its own pre-flight guard is what failed it, before any UPDATE ran), so per the rule established in v3.12.2/v3.13.1, editing it directly is the retry path the runner is built for
